label: Contract and custom curve interface
summary: A bounded interface for project-specific contract pricing or custom curve implementations and independent reference models.
maturityMeaning: Hash-bound reference scaffold only; project-specific implementation and evidence are required before prototype readiness.
requiredFacts: Specify the exact curve domain, invariant, rounding direction and boundary behavior
Bind quote-to-execution parity for exact-input and exact-output paths
Define reserve, liability, partial-fill, withdrawal and retirement behavior
hardConflictPredicates: Two economically equivalent executions can extract different value solely by fragmentation
A quoted exact-output amount can settle for more than the user-bound maximum input
Any reachable curve state creates unbacked value or traps a declared user exit
